purpose: Labeled golden set for the DSPy-lane provider A/B (openai/gpt-5.6-terra baseline vs anthropic candidates). Scored on the two real intent surfaces riding DSPY_LM_MODEL: cognitive RAG IntentClassificationSignature and chatbot ChatbotIntentClassificationSignature. Labels are acceptable-sets (prediction correct iff in set); null excludes the query from that taxonomy's accuracy.
labeling_notes: Hand-labeled 2026-07-18 against the signature docstrings/descs. production_predicted is the historical chatbot-lane prediction (gpt-4o era) recorded in chatbot_training_signals - used as context, NOT as ground truth. Sources: chatbot_training_signals(id=N,n=freq) = real production query; disproof_2026-07-18 = queries from the pre-plan disproof probe; synthetic_coverage = added because real traffic contains no PREDICTION and little GAP_ANALYSIS/EXPERIMENT_DESIGN.
